description: Permissoes minimas do nucleo do Tauri para a janela principal do LearnVault desktop. Deny-by-default: alem do conjunto padrao do nucleo (app, event, window, webview, menu, tray, image, resources, path) so os comandos IPC app-defined desta fatia (desktop_config, desktop_catalog e desktop_select_library) sao concedidos. O seletor nativo roda internamente no Rust via tauri-plugin-dialog e nao e concedido ao webview. Sem shell, process, http, fs amplo, dialog, store, remote ou updater.
